name: Standing Pullover (Cable)
instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley, holding a straight bar with both hands.
With a slight elbow bend, pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Keep the arms straight and feel the lats contract.
Return slowly to the start. Isolates the lats without biceps involvement.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate cable pull-pattern exercise for the lats. Standing Pullover (Cable) strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
